question: Should OpenClaw publish `api.registerReadinessCriterion` and `gateway.readiness` selector IDs as supported V1 compatibility surfaces, or should plugin registration be deferred from the readiness rollout?
rationale: This is a new external Plugin SDK API and operator-facing configuration behavior; code review cannot choose the permanent contract, ownership, and compatibility commitment safely.

options.title: Defer plugin registration
options.body: Land no public plugin readiness callback until maintainers choose and document the supported Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Approve the V1 contract
options.body: Accept the callback and namespaced selector IDs as supported surfaces, with compatibility expectations and upgrade behavior made explicit before merge.

recommendation.title: Defer plugin registration
recommendation.body: Land no public plugin readiness callback until maintainers choose and document the supported Plugin SDK contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the readiness proposal stack and can provide the intended contract rationale, but approval must come from a repository decision owner.
